text: Julia's driving test is on 14 May. She failed the first one on a roundabout and is properly nervous this time. Remind me to text her good luck that morning.

Spoke to Siddharth on the phone. He's applied for the senior analyst role at the council and should hear back by the 3rd of June. If he gets an interview it'll be the week after, and he's already asked his old manager Teresa to be a referee. He's been at his current place for six years and is ready for a change.
Farid lives in Leeds now, just off the ring road. Works for a logistics firm as a planner.
Joy has her grade 6 piano exam on Saturday. Her teacher thinks she's ready but Joy doesn't.
Need to renew my passport before 12/07 and book the boiler service.
Rosa's daughter Mia got into the youth orchestra after her audition last week! Rosa was beaming.
Owen had his second interview at the bank this afternoon. I should message him the next day to see how it went.
Asha's husband is a paramedic and they've got two boys, both at the primary on Elm Road.
Ignacio's interview got cancelled, they've frozen hiring. He's applying elsewhere instead and seemed fine about it.
Coffee with Vanessa. Her son Tomás sits his A level maths on 9 June and then chemistry a week after. She's more stressed than he is.

Irina works nights at the hospital lab and lives with her sister in Croydon. Her parents are still in Bucharest and her dad runs a small garage there. She's been in the UK since 2015 and has just applied for citizenship, though she said the forms took her about three weekends to get through.
Ravi passed his driving test! Third attempt. Don't forget to get him a little keyring or something to celebrate.
Varun mentioned he's sitting the civil service exam on the 21st of November. Asked me not to tell his parents in case it goes badly. Ask him how it went afterwards.

Tariq's results day is Thursday. He's hoping for the grades to get into Manchester for engineering, otherwise it's Sheffield through clearing. His mum says he's pretending not to care but he hasn't eaten properly all week. His older sister Ruby got her results the same way two years ago and is taking him for breakfast that morning.

Mustafa and his wife Zara both have interviews at the same school on 2 October, which is a bit awkward. He's going for head of science, she's applying for the SENCo job. They're keeping it light at home. I should text them both the day before.
Ruby's brother Rhys works offshore, two weeks on, two weeks off.

Yetunde has her bar exams in February. She's revising every evening after work and said she's barely sleeping, which isn't like her. Her sister Joy is coming down to stay the week before to cook and keep her sane. I should check in on her in a couple of weeks, and maybe drop off some food.
Emily got the job at the publishing house! Starts on 1st of March.
Called Mum. Aunt Helen's grandson has his black belt grading on the 18th.
Aditi's dog Pepper is booked in for the vet on Monday. She also has her nursing interview that afternoon, so she's a bit frazzled.
Teresa lives in the flat above the bakery. Her partner is a firefighter in Hackney.
Remind me to ask Javier how his audition for the Ensemble went. It was yesterday.

Haruto is studying for his JLPT N1 in December, which he says is the hardest one. He's really into old Ghibli films at the moment and watches them without subtitles as practice. He also mentioned his grandmother in Osaka turns ninety on 3rd of January and the whole family is flying out for it.
Ioana's mum is a retired GP and still lives in Cluj. Ioana visits twice a year.
Georgia has her final interview with the charity on 27/10. Must send her the notes I made on their annual report the day before.
Wiremu said the job at the port fell through, they gave it to an internal candidate. He's gutted.

Long chat with Dana after book club. She's finally applying for the head of HR role at the hospital trust, deadline is 30 September. Her boss is leaving at Christmas and she thinks she has a decent shot, but she's worried about the presentation part of the interview. Her husband Owen is going to do mock questions with her the weekend before. I should offer to read her personal statement.
Siddharth's sister passed her medical finals. The family are having a big dinner on the 5th of August.
Note to self: theory test is 3 March, practical sometime in April.
Julia mentioned her dad is a long-distance lorry driver and her mum runs a dog grooming business in Bristol.
Asha said Mia's eleven plus is on 15 September. Mia's fine but Asha is the nervous one.
Farid's son Tariq has his first proper job interview next week, at an architecture practice. Remind me to ask Farid how Tariq got on.
Joy and her partner both work for the same insurance company in Reading, different floors.
Vanessa is retaking her accountancy exam on 11 December. Says she'll celebrate either way that evening at the Red Lion.
Rosa's cat Biscuit is fourteen now. Rosa works from home most days so she can keep an eye on him.
Owen didn't get the bank job. They said he came a close second. He's applying for a similar role in Cardiff.

Ravi's audition for the drama school is on 4 April, and the results come out about a fortnight later. He's been rehearsing his monologue every night. His mum keeps asking me whether he'd actually go if he got in. Don't forget to message him the night before.
Spoke to Irina about her brother Varun. He lives in Vancouver now and works for a games studio.
Exam board marking finishes on 20 July, so I'm free from the 21st.

Helen's interview for the deputy head post was moved to 8 November because one of the governors is away. She's prepping all half term and has to give a twenty minute presentation on behaviour policy. She sounded confident but admitted she hasn't done an interview in eleven years. Remind me to ring her the evening before.
Zara's daughter has her ballet exam on Saturday morning. Zara says she's been practising in the kitchen non-stop.
Need to email Mustafa the reference by Friday. He's got his interview on the 14th and they want it in a few days before.
Ignacio lives in Valencia with his parents while he finishes his PhD. His brother Javi teaches in Madrid.
Yetunde's younger brother is starting his apprenticeship interview process. I said I'd help with mock interviews on the weekend.
Emily said her mum is going in for her citizenship test on 22 June. Emily thinks she's overthinking it. Remind me to text Emily that evening to see how it went.
Rhys and Georgia are both sitting their CFA level one on 15 May, so they're revising together every Sunday.
Aditi didn't get the nursing post but they've asked her to apply again in the spring. She was relieved more than anything.
Teresa's son Haruto is applying to medical school. Interviews are in January and he has his UCAT on 2 August.
Wiremu is from Rotorua originally. He's been in London about six years and works in construction.

Talked to Dana Nguyen at the school gate. Her twins have their SATs the week of 12 May. She wants them to just enjoy the week afterwards, so they're going camping in the Lakes the weekend after. I'm minding their rabbit Clover while they're away.
Javier's PhD viva was called off because the external examiner is ill. It's been pushed back indefinitely.
Tomás Fischer has started at a law firm in Edinburgh. He's living in Leith with two friends from uni.
Ruby has her job interview at the museum on Tuesday. She's been dropping hints that she'd love a nice leather notebook if she gets it.
Remind me to call Julia the day after her results come out on 13 August. She needs an A in biology.
Joy's dad, Dr Petrov, is a dentist in Sheffield and her mum teaches piano.
Farid said the interview at the airport went well. They'll let him know by the end of the month.
Book a mock driving test with the instructor and renew the car insurance before 1/11.

Rosa's nephew Owen has his firefighter fitness test on 6 June and then the interview a week after. Rosa says he's been running every morning. I should send him a good luck message the night before the fitness test.
Siddharth's wife Asha works for the NHS in Birmingham. Their daughter is at uni in Leeds.
Mustafa got the head of science job! He found out that morning and rang everyone. Send congrats and maybe get a card.
